turns.q: My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
turns.replyTail:
enu
If your tracking shows “delivered” but you didn’t receive it, it can sometimes be marked delivered 1–2 days early. We recommend: checking for an attempted-delivery notice, looking around the delivery area, asking if someone else accepted it (neighbor/office/roommate), and contacting your local post office to see if they still have it.
If it still hasn’t turned up, please file a claim with the courier—and if the package hasn’t been located in 5 business days, contact us again so we can help.
